newsitem.title: USA: Compaq reduces ProSignia prices in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Compaq reduces ProSignia prices in U.S..

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp said Thursday it has reduced prices on some of its ProSignia servers by up to 17 percent.
The price cuts, which are taking place after similar price cuts in August, are being offered only in the United States.

The models affected by the price change are ProSignia 300 5/90 Model 1/E; ProSignia 300 5/120 Model 1; ProSignia 300 5/120 Model 2100; ProSignia 300 5/150 Model 1; ProSignia 300 5/150 Model 2100; ProSignia 500 5/150 Model 1; and ProSignia 500 5/150 Model 2100.
The previous price ranges for those models were between $1,889 and $4,154. The new range is from $1,667 to $3,599.
